codeEphoto.texte_accordeon:
Do you need to provide a digital signature ePhoto code (or ePhoto code) for an online request on the ANTS website?

It's very simple, go to the Smartphone-iD website: ID Photo and ePhoto Application. Download the app, choose the document you need (Driver's License, Residence Permit, DCEM, etc.). Then take your photo and signature on your smartphone, and you're done. After your photo is validated by our team of experts, you'll receive your ePhoto code in your email inbox within minutes.
codeEphoto.titre_accordeon: How to obtain an ePhoto code?

codeEphoto.texte_accordeon:
The ePhoto code is written on the photo sheet, which is available:

  • on the 'Official ID Photo' app by Smartphone iD, under the 'Order Tracking' menu
  • directly in the email you received. In this email, the ePhoto code is also indicated.
codeEphoto.titre_accordeon: Where can I find the ePhoto code?

codeEphoto.texte_accordeon:
You have 2 options:

  • You can either copy the 22-character ePhoto code (letters and numbers) from your photo sheet. Be careful to write the letters in uppercase and not to include any spaces 🙂
  • Or you can copy and paste the ePhoto code provided in the email you received.
codeEphoto.titre_accordeon: How to enter the ePhoto code?

codeEphoto.texte_accordeon:
The ePhoto code is single-use. Once you’ve entered it on the ANTS website, you won’t be able to use it again.

The ANTS secures your data by preventing the reuse of ePhoto codes.
codeEphoto.titre_accordeon: How many times can the ePhoto code be used?

codeEphoto.texte_accordeon:
The ePhoto code is valid for 6 months. This corresponds to the validity period of your ID photo.

You have 6 months to use it; after that, it will no longer work.
codeEphoto.titre_accordeon: How long is the ePhoto code valid?

codeEphoto.texte_accordeon:
On a photo sheet, there is ONE ePhoto code.

If you need another ePhoto code, you can get one without retaking your photo and signature, as long as it is within 6 months. To do this, go to the 'Order Tracking' menu of the 'Official ID Photo' app by Smartphone iD, select your order, then request a new ePhoto code. You will receive it within minutes.
codeEphoto.titre_accordeon: How many ePhoto codes are there on a photo sheet?

codeEphoto.texte_accordeon:
Several reasons are possible:

  • You made a mistake when entering your ePhoto code. The letters must be uppercase, you must enter all 22 characters without spaces, and you might have confused the letters O with the numbers 0.
  • You have already used this ePhoto code. Since the ePhoto code is single-use, request a new ePhoto code directly from the 'Official ID Photo' app by Smartphone iD.

If your order is less than 6 months old, it’s simple, no need to retake your photo and signature. Go to the 'Order Tracking' menu, select your order, and request a new ePhoto code.

If your order is more than 6 months old, in that case, place a new order and receive the ePhoto code within minutes.
codeEphoto.titre_accordeon: Why isn't my ePhoto code working?

codeEphoto.texte_accordeon: It's very simple, go to the ANTS website Driver's License - Home (ants.gouv.fr), choose the reason for your request (request for registration for the driving license exam, request for the production of your driving license, etc.), then fill out the displayed form. In the 'digital signature photo code' field, enter your ePhoto code, and that’s it!

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
French ID photos must comply with the ISO/IEC 19794-5:2005 standard.

The ID photo size must be 35×45 mm.

Main points to follow:

  • Do not wear any accessories on your hair (hats, visible hair ties).
  • Adopt a neutral expression, mouth closed. No smile.
  • Your entire face must be visible (eyes, eyebrows, ears, neck).
  • For long hair, place it behind your shoulders.
  • Do not wear glasses, except with a specific medical certificate.

Make your life easier, Smartphone iD takes care of checking all these points for you and guarantees that you present a valid ID photo. No more risk of your request being rejected by the administration.

More info at https://www.smartphone-id.com/en/compliant-id-photo/

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
An ID photo must be taken by an authorized professional; otherwise, it will not be accepted by the administration.

Several solutions are available to you:

  • Stay at home and use the Smartphone iD app, a certified ID photo provider.
  • Go to an authorized photographer or a certified photo booth.

With Smartphone iD, taking an ID photo is child’s play. No need to go anywhere, take your photo on your smartphone at your convenience. We will ensure your photo meets the standards, and you will receive it directly in your email inbox.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: How to take an ID photo?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
The photo must be taken either:

  • On a mobile app using a system approved by the Ministry of the Interior.
  • By an authorized professional, such as a photographer.
  • In a photo booth using a system approved by the Ministry of the Interior.

Depending on the medium chosen, the services are not identical, and the price can vary greatly.

Smartphone iD is the only service that guarantees your ID photo meets the standards required by the administration at the lowest price on the market.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: Where to take ID photos near me?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
With Smartphone iD, you receive your photo sheet directly in your email inbox.

Do you need a printed version of your photo sheet? You have 3 options:

  • Request the printing and mailing of your photo sheet when ordering with Smartphone iD. Your photo sheet is printed by photo printing specialists and mailed within 24 hours.
  • If you’ve already placed your order, no worries. Log in with your email on the 'Official ID Photo' app by Smartphone iD. Click on the 'Order Tracking' menu and request the printing and mailing of your photo sheet.
  • Print your photo sheet yourself, either on your personal photo printer or at a photo kiosk. This choice is not recommended for two reasons:
    • The print format is different for each type of printer, and it can be tedious to find the right one to obtain photos in the required size of 35×45 mm.
    • The administration requires high-quality printing and professional photo paper.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: How to print a photo in ID format?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
Taking an ID photo that looks good is not always easy.

With Smartphone iD, take as many photos as you want, the photo sessions are unlimited. This way, you’re sure to have THE ID photo you want.

At a photographer, you only get one shot.

In photo booths, you get 3 shots, and then you have to choose.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: How to take a good ID photo?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
Keep it simple. The ID photo should be as natural as possible.

The best is to leave your hair down. If it’s long, place it behind your shoulders so your face is clearly visible. You can choose to tie your hair, but in this case, no hair ties should be visible, and the hairstyle should not be too elaborate.

If you have bangs, make sure they don’t cover your eyebrows; otherwise, you risk rejection by the administration.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: How to style your hair for an ID photo?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon: Yes, you can wear makeup in your ID photo. However, the makeup should be light. Do not use overly bold colors on your eyes or lips. The ID photo should be as natural as possible.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: Can you wear makeup for an ID photo?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon: Yes, you can wear earrings in your ID photo if they are discreet. Earrings that are too flashy or bulky will be rejected by the administration.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: Can you wear earrings in an ID photo?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
No, we advise against wearing glasses in your ID photo. The administration accepts very few photos with glasses because the criteria are very strict.

Only those with a medical certificate requiring them to wear glasses in their ID photo are allowed. In that case, they must follow these rules:

  • Do not wear thick frames.
  • Your eyes and eyebrows must not be covered by the frame.
  • There should be no reflection on the lenses.
  • Colored or tinted lenses are prohibited.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: Can you keep your glasses on for an ID photo?
